nm-1.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production UI stat emblem icons for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG growth screen. Image1 is the existing skill-tree icon atlas of this game: match its painterly dark-metal style, glowing accents, dark outlines and readability at small size; never copy its icons. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly FIVE separate round emblem medallions in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, row 1 cells 1-3, row 2 cells 4-5, and the sixth cell (bottom-right) left completely EMPTY. Each emblem is a circular dark iron medallion with an ornate rim and ONE clear symbol, crimson-violet glowing accents (nightmare tier): (1) a tower shield with folded black wings (transcendent guard), (2) a crescent sword slash wrapped in a spiralling wind (transcendent swiftness), (3) NOT a medallion: a single jagged black crystal shard with a glowing crimson core and black mist (nightmare shard crafting material), (4) a cracked crimson eye inside a thorn ring (nightmare mark), (5) a swirling black vortex rift with crimson light (abyss rift). Each clearly readable at small icon size. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no characters.
